payout_quote: Earn $100 cash back when you spend $500 on purchases in the first 90 days from account opening.
steps: Open the official AAA Preferred Rewards Visa page and read the offer terms.
Apply for the AAA Preferred Rewards Visa; a hard credit inquiry is part of the application.
Spend at least $500 on purchases in the first 90 days — only spending you already planned.
Pay the balance in full each month.
Collect the $100 cash back once the requirement is met.
catches: Never spend extra solely to earn the bonus — only count the $500 of purchases you were already going to make.
No annual fee ($0), so the $100 cash back is yours to keep net if you meet the spend.
Applying triggers a hard inquiry on your credit report, which can temporarily lower your score.

Carried-balance interest erases the bonus: carrying a balance at a typical ~20%+ variable APR wipes out the $100 fast — always pay in full (check the cardmember agreement for the exact APR before you apply).
Regional AAA club product (this page is AAA Mountain West Group) — availability and the issuing bank can vary by AAA region, so confirm the offer applies in your area.
biggest_catch: This is a regional AAA club card — the offer and issuing bank vary by AAA region, so confirm it is available to you; and never stretch spending to hit $500, since carried-balance interest at ~20%+ APR erases the $100 quickly.
eligibility: New AAA Preferred Rewards Visa cardholders; $500 in purchases within the first 90 days of account opening; regional AAA availability may vary.
timing: Bonus paid after the $500/90-day requirement is met; exact posting timing not stated in the fetched copy.
